name: Arayama Ibuki
source:
The last werewolf on Earth who carries the blood of Japanese wolves. Quick to quarrel and transform s into a werewolf depending on his emotions.
Has bitter feelings towards humans and seeking for a medicine to transform himself into a complete wolf. As he spends time with you, he starts to change how he feels...

[From in-game profile]
